title: Structural transition of the immature poxvirus scaffold from preassembly to the scaffold lattice.
authors: Jang, Yeontae; Kim, Seungmi; Lee, Seu-Na; Ryu, Bumhan; Jeong, Hyeongseop; Kang, Eun Sung; Sul, Jae Hoon; Bae, Hayeon; Kim, Yong Ho; Jo, Dong-Gyu; Hyun, Jaekyung
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜解析痘病毒支架蛋白D13的组装构象转变，虽涉及蛋白质结构，但核心是病毒形态发生的实验结构表征，未采用AI或物理模拟计算方法，与蛋白质结构计算建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: During poxvirus morphogenesis, the external scaffold defines the shape and size of immature virions. However, its structural characterization has been hindered by the pleomorphic nature of authentic virus particles. Here, we present single-particle cryo-electron microscopy and cryo-electron tomography structures of two distinct in vitro assemblies of the vaccinia virus scaffold protein D13 that recapitulate oligomeric states previously observed in situ. These structures reveal a dramatic transition from rod-like oligomers, representing a pre-assembly state, to a fully formed scaffold, triggered by the docking of the N-terminal peptide of the viral membrane protein A17 into the base cavity of D13. We propose that this interaction destabilizes the pre-assembly conformation and initiates scaffold formation upon viral membrane recruitment, ultimately leading to the formation of immature virions. Our findings provide structural insights into the early stages of poxvirus morphogenesis and establish a mechanistic link between conformational changes in D13 and scaffold assembly.
abstract_zh: 在痘病毒形态发生过程中，外部支架决定了未成熟病毒粒子的形状和大小。然而，其结构表征一直受到真实病毒粒子多形性特征的阻碍。在此，我们展示了牛痘病毒支架蛋白D13的两种不同体外组装体的单颗粒冷冻电子显微镜和冷冻电子断层扫描结构，这些结构重现了先前在原位观察到的寡聚状态。这些结构揭示了从杆状寡聚体（代表预组装状态）到完全形成支架的显著转变，这一转变由病毒膜蛋白A17的N端肽段对接至D13的基底腔所触发。我们提出，这种相互作用破坏了预组装构象的稳定性，并在病毒膜招募时启动支架形成，最终导致未成熟病毒粒子的生成。我们的发现为痘病毒形态发生的早期阶段提供了结构见解，并建立了D13构象变化与支架组装之间的机制联系。
